_about: Public-domain William Derham (1657-1735), rector of Upminster, Canon of Windsor and Boyle lecturer, for the Word Hoard: Physico-Theology (Boyle Lectures 1711-12) and Astro-Theology (1715), his demonstrations of the being and attributes of God from the works of creation. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 87 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

derham-physico-theology: Physico-theology : or, a demonstration of the being and attributes of God, from his works of creation : being the substance of sixteen sermons preached in St. Mary-le-Bow-Church, London, at the honourable Mr. Boyle's lectures in the years 1711, and 1712 (London : Printed for W. and J. Innys, 1720)
derham-astro-theology: Astro-theology : or a demonstration of the being and attributes of God, from a survey of the heavens (London : Printed for W. and J. Innys, 1721)

_excluded.derham-science: The Artificial Clock-maker, his Philosophical Transactions papers, and his editions of John Ray and Robert Hooke
